page_title: ATA 0-1 LAZ | Atalanta v Lazio 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Daniele Chiffi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' A pass from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is intercepted by Christos Mandas and the move breaks down.
90+1' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
90+1' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) prepares to take a corner kick.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

88' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
88' Daniele Chiffi shows a yellow card to Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) for a tough tackle.
85' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
84' Boulaye Dia comes off the pitch to be replaced by Matias Vecino (Lazio).
83' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Daniel Maldini was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball.
78' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) replacing Ederson.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Daniele Chiffi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' The corner kick from Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
75' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) replaces Mateo Retegui.
74' Here comes a substitution. Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is brought on as a substitute for Ademola Lookman.

74' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the top of the net is far too weak and Marco Carnesecchi makes a simple save. The ball goes out for a corner. Lazio can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the left side of the goal, but the keeper dives and denies him.
71' A corner kick by Atalanta is thwarted by the well prepared Christos Mandas (Lazio).
71' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ederson (Atalanta), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Atalanta get a corner.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) replaces Mattia Zaccagni.
68' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Samuel Gigot leaves the pitch to be replaced by Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio).
67' Christos Mandas leaps to intercept the corner kick from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).

67' A cross is whipped into the box by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) and Mateo Retegui controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention. The ball is out of play. Atalanta win a corner kick.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.
58' The substitution is prepared. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Juan Cuadrado.
54' 0 - 1 Goal! Fisayo Dele-Bashiru gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Gustav Isaksen (Lazio), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 0:1.

54' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
50' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

50' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Christos Mandas anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atalanta.

48' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
46' Half-time substitution. Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) will not participate anymore and Gustav Isaksen is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Atalanta work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45+2' The ball is cleared after Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
42' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
41' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
41' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
40' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Chiffi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
34' Marco Baroni is forced to make a change. Nuno Tavares is unable to continue due to injury, Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) comes on.
32' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
29' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
28' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
27' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle as Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
25' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
24' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
22' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
21' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
15' The corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is cleared away by the defence.

15' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag and Atalanta will take a corner.
13' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) passes the ball onto Mateo Retegui, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
5' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
5' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.
3' The foul by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) was seen by Daniele Chiffi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
2' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) will deliver the corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lazio will kick the game off.
Daniele Chiffi will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
